cues.en: of the John Reber plan was going to be. In the nineteen forties and fifties, a man named John Reber had a plan to completely change the San Francisco Bay. Enormous dams would create freshwater lakes. There'd be brand new reclaimed land for industry and for air and naval bases. Reber said it would make the bay a defensible military fortification,
cues.zh: 上世纪四五十年代，一个叫John Reber的人有个彻底改造旧金山湾的计划。巨大的水坝会造出淡水湖，还会有全新的填海土地用于工业、空军和海军基地。Reber说，这能让旧金山湾成为易守难攻的军事要塞，

cues.en: Rieber was not a professional engineer. He was a theatrical producer who'd done a lot of research.
cues.zh: 里伯不是专业工程师。他是个戏剧制片人，做过大量研究。

cues.en: But because he worked in showbiz,
cues.zh: 但因为他在演艺圈工作，

cues.zh: 他知道怎么推广东西。而且据多数人说，他是个友善、真诚、

cues.zh: 有说服力的人。

cues.en: So unlike other ideas for giant engineering projects, the Rieber plan actually caught on. Debate went back and forth for years, but eventually, Rieber's plan seemed realistic enough, at least to politicians,
cues.zh: 所以和其他巨型工程项目的设想不同，里伯的方案居然真的被接受了。争论来来回回持续了好几年，但最终，里伯的方案似乎足够现实，至少在政客们看来是这样，

cues.en: in the water measuring the various different ebb and flow of the tide. It took three years for Rieber's plan to be tested here. And in that time, Rieber passed away.

cues.en: And for his supporters, the results from the model were devastating.
cues.zh: 对支持者来说，模型的结果是毁灭性的。

cues.en: It looked great on paper, convinced a lot of people,
cues.zh: 纸面上看很棒，说服了很多人，

cues.en: but when it was tested, they found that it was only good on paper.
cues.zh: 但一测试就发现，它只在纸面上好看。

cues.en: The end result was it failed on 99 different accounts. Wild and unpredictable

cues.en: In short, not only would the Reba plan have been a disaster,
cues.zh: 简而言之，雷巴计划不仅会是一场灾难，

cues.en: it would have been a billion dollar disaster. The ecosystem would have been devastated too, but it was the fifties, so no one was really thinking about that. The core of engineers, their job done, figured the model would come in useful again someday, and it did, helping to test smaller and more practical schemes across the bay for decades.
cues.zh: 还会是十亿美元的灾难。生态系统也会遭到严重破坏，但那是五十年代，所以没人在意这些。核心工程师们完成了任务，认为这个模型将来还能派上用场，确实如此，几十年来它帮助测试了海湾对岸更小、更实用的方案。

cues.en: These days, of course, computers can do all that for a fraction of the time and the money, but it's still a good educational resource.
cues.zh: 如今，当然，计算机只需花费极少的时间和金钱就能完成这一切，但它仍然是一个很好的教育资源。

cues.en: Last time, I talked about a grand civil engineering scheme like this, about Hermann Zergal's Atlantropa.
cues.zh: 上次，我谈到了一个像这样宏大的土木工程方案，关于赫尔曼·泽加尔的亚特兰特罗帕。

cues.en: I said it was a testament to how big we can dream, but this model is a testament to something else, to science,
cues.zh: 我说过，这证明了我们能有多大的梦想，但这个模型证明了另一件事，那就是科学，

cues.en: to having a hypothesis,
cues.zh: 证明有假设，

cues.en: to testing it, and then when it fails, admitting that it's wrong. There shouldn't be any shame in that. Sometimes we follow bad ideas,
cues.zh: 去验证它，然后当它失败时，承认它是错的。对此不应有任何羞耻。有时我们会追随糟糕的想法，
